value.rationale: PASS: Bad reductions of the classical cyclic Klein hypersurfaces are a natural geometric gap: knowing smoothness over C is insufficient to describe the special fibers. A uniform finite group-scheme description, exact support counts and nonreduced local algebras determine meaningful singularity geometry for every s,d in a broad infinite family. This is not merely a finite-field census, a substitution or an unmotivated invariant.
